verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with multiple weighted variants (A/B/n), used to serve feature variations in experiments. Its docs also position it as managing 'feature flags and remote config', so dynamic configuration values beyond booleans are a core offering. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported value types (strings, numbers, JSON), detail on how SDKs read typed config values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
